items.title: Charlie Bocage Interview, 1960-07-18
items.q: Well Frank said, uh, Danny took sick with indigestion and Frank says, Man, I only got 45 minutes before the show.

ctx.x: The Find out who played in that band and stuff like that with Buddy Petit.

Yeah, I love playing with Buddy a while. In fact, I played with him a while and then I went with other little aggregations, you know, one night stands. Back those days, men would hire. They needed a guitar player or something. They just come and hire you, you know. I didn't keep no particular regular.

This boy Danny Small was, he was doing a dancing, a song and dance team. He would act with a girl by the name Ida Brown in the review. That's not Small's Paradise. That's not... No, not him. This boy was named Small, but he was an entertainer. And, uh... Well Frank said, uh, Danny took sick with indigestion and Frank says, Man, I only got 45 minutes before the show. He said, What I'm gonna do to fill out that spot? You know, oh man, he would know it was type of fill. He was going like that. So I said, uh, say…
